description: Browse, filter and visualize Classic Workflows and Power Automate flows from the Dataverse workflow table as interactive process maps (XAML for workflows, JSON for flows). Collapse and expand scopes, loops and conditions to tame large flows; click any step to inspect its full inputs, expressions and pretty-printed fetchXml; send queries straight to FetchXML Builder. Export a single process to PDF, HTML, SVG (Visio/Mural compatible) or PNG, or generate a browsable HTML documentation pack for every process with one click.
releaseNotes: 1.0.21: Large-map readability overhaul - children now align under their parents, a container's actions stay grouped together, every connector gets its own clean lane (gaps stretch to fit) and overlapping loops get separate rails; click a step to highlight its connections and dim the rest; full-screen mode for the map (button top-right, Esc to exit); automated regression test suite. 1.0.20: Collapsible scopes, loops and conditions in the preview ([+]/[-] on container nodes); send a step's fetchXml straight to FetchXML Builder; copy any detail value; PNG export; bulk "Export All HTML" documentation pack with index page; details now include every input field dynamically; fixed flows failing to render when an action has scalar inputs. 1.0.19: Click a step to see its full inputs in a new details pane (all parameters, wrapped values, pretty-printed fetchXml); HTML export now embeds a crisp vector SVG diagram, a collapsible step tree with per-step details and expand/collapse all; fixed oversized text in exported diagrams and clipped long titles. 1.0.18: Crossing reduction in the layout - child actions are now ordered under their parents so connectors no longer cross. 1.0.17: Orthogonal connectors with lane separation and readable branch labels, fit-to-width auto-scaling preview, SVG export (Visio/Mural compatible), name filter boxes, flow list shows Created On/Created By/Modified By/Owner/Scope. 1.0.15: Add summary and release notes, remove SPDX license element for Tool Library compatibility. 1.0.0: Initial release - two-tab UI for Power Automate flows and classic workflows, GDI+ process maps, PDF and HTML export.
summary: Visualize Dataverse workflows and Power Automate flows as interactive, collapsible process maps with step details and PDF/HTML/SVG/PNG export.
title: Dataverse Process Mapper
